uw_signs.description: Campus Wayfinding Project sign family (Entro Communications), installed 2020-2023. Charcoal/black slim monoliths with sloped top edge, gold perforated-metal band along the slope (and a large diagonal gold band on lower third of entrance pillars), gold building code letters, white names, UW wordmark+crest on site IDs.
uw_signs.placement: Freestanding building entrance signs stand on the paving beside the main door, offset to one side; wall-mounted beside door; horizontal over door head. Main entrance: staggered trio (large/medium/small) of primary site ID pillars on landscaping at the NW corner of University Ave W & Ring Rd/Seagram Dr (~43.4690,-80.5395), facing University Ave.

letter_sign.description: Dimensional 'UNIVERSITY OF / WATERLOO' letters, dark charcoal on light grey concrete plinth; relocated 2020 to between Arts Quad and Grad House

ion_station_sign.description: University of Waterloo ION station ID tower: rectangular box clad in checkerboard glass panels; top band black glass with brushed-silver 3D 'University of Waterloo' letters, ION logo left and GRT logo right in blue

uw_signs.confidence: high for dimensions/system (official drawings); medium for installed colours
